modules.name: database
modules.behavior: Singleton pool; transaction owner commits/rolls back; callers borrow transaction handles.

modules.name: users
modules.behavior: Static connection import; getUser(id,tenantId) public API must retain tenant filter.

modules.name: billing
modules.behavior: Shares transaction with user provisioning; charge(id,cents,tenantId) is public.

modules.name: jobs
modules.behavior: Worker acquires connection per attempt; retries preserve stable idempotency key.

modules.name: http
modules.behavior: Composition root may inject dependencies; route handler signatures remain unchanged.

modules.name: tests
modules.behavior: Test tenant separation, one-owner commit/rollback, retry idempotency and API compatibility.
